dict.string: MPG Site Records uses the camera so you can take before, during and completion photos of your work and capture supplier receipts on site. Photos are timestamped and attached to the job.
MPG Site Records lets you attach existing photos, receipts and supplier invoices from your library to a job or daily record.
MPG Site Records can save site photos you capture back to your photo library.

MPG Site Records uses your location only when you clock in or out, or upload site evidence, to confirm you are on or near the allocated site. Your location is never tracked continuously in the background.
